import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long x = sc.nextLong();
        long y = sc.nextLong();
        long n = sc.nextLong();
        sc.close();

        long bestNum = 0, bestDen = 1, bestDiff = x;

        for (long den = 1; den <= n; ++den) {
            long numBase = Math.max(x * den / y - 10, 0L);
            for (long i = 0; i < 20; ++i) {
                long num = numBase + i;
                long diff = (x * den > num * y) ? (x * den - num * y) : (num * y - x * den);
                if (bestDiff * den > diff * bestDen) {
                    bestDiff = diff;
                    bestNum = num;
                    bestDen = den;
                } else if (bestDiff * den == diff * bestDen) {
                    if (bestDen > den || (bestDen == den && bestNum > num)) {
                        bestNum = num;
                        bestDen = den;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(bestNum + "/" + bestDen);
    }
}
